note: Preview gallery for ui_gallery: the faction page of the PDA, its member row and the FACTIONS pane of the VPP window. The row's host is the list width minus the scrollbar (602 - 10). A fixture travels to the bridge as one JSON string of at most ~1000 bytes on the wire.

entries.name: page-faction
entries.note: The host is the WHOLE page area, not the page's own 642x518: the root stands at position 640 0, because this is the right half of the contacts tab, and a host only as wide as the half would leave all but its first 2 units outside the picture. The empty left half of the shot is where the base mod draws contacts.

entries.name: factions-vpp
entries.note: The pane is 1000x524 but stands at [0, vpp.paneY] inside the window, so the host is the 1000x620 window it lands in, not the pane's own rectangle. The pane's root is hidden -- ShowPane is what reveals the open tab -- so the fixture shows PaneFactions before it fills anything.
